title: Awards & Recognition | 20+ Years Microsoft Excellence | Quadra
description: Recognized through Microsoft partner awards, Quadra represents 20+ years of excellence, innovation, and enterprise technology leadership.

blocks.text: Our awards are more than trophies on a shelf. They are the validation of our enduring commitment to our partners' success and the tangible proof of our ability to architect solutions that consistently lead the industry
20 Consecutive Years of Microsoft Global Recognition

For two decades, through every major technology shift, Quadra has been honored by Microsoft on the world stage for our innovation, customer impact, and architectural excellence. This unbroken streak is unmatched in India and stands as the ultimate testament to our ability to help our partners stay ahead of the curve. It is the foundation of the trust you place in us
In an industry defined by constant change, our consistency is our hallmark
First Citrix Specialist Partner for Virtualization in India
Gold Partner of the Year – South India, Sri Lanka, Maldives
Pre-Sales Engineer of the Year – South India
V Champion Award – Solution Provider Award
Growth Partner of the year – APJ
Emerging Partner of the year – South India
Each moment captured is more than a memory, it’s a cornerstone in the architecture of our success. Together, they tell the story of growth, resilience, and enduring ambition.
Our awards are not about us. They are a promise to you
You are partnering with a team that has been consistently judged by the industry's highest standards and has been found to be a leader, year after year. We architect with proven excellence.
Discover how our values and vision can help you architect your own success story
